issues.description: `Client.main()` in the solution calls `assembleBookstore()` with no arguments, but the solution defines `assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore` requiring one parameter. This is an internal inconsistency in the solution (will not compile) and also conflicts with the template/problem expectation of a parameterless `assembleBookstore()` factory method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the template/spec and its own call site by changing `private static func assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore` to `private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore` (remove the `seed` parameter). Alternatively, pass a `seed` argument from `main()` and update the template/problem statement to match, but the simplest is to remove `seed`.
